us-states.js
The simplified GeoJSON state boundary file is carried over from the v8 application.

us-roads-2025.json
Source: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2025 Primary Roads, 2025
Primary and Secondary Roads and 2025 National Places Gazetteer.
https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/PRIMARYROADS/tl_2025_us_primaryroads.zip
https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/PRISECROADS/
https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2025_Gazetteer/2025_Gaz_place_national.zip

Includes a generalized selection of contiguous-US interstate corridors and
regional primary/secondary roads in the Dallas/Fort Worth, New York/New Jersey,
Seattle/Tacoma/Fife and Los Angeles areas. Place labels use gazetteer internal
points. Data have been cropped, simplified, quantized to 1e-4 degrees,
delta encoded and filtered to reduce payload and clutter. The source datum
is NAD83. This schematic basemap has no turn instructions, traffic, address
lookup, truck restrictions or commercial routing guarantees. Dispatch routes
and estimated miles are calculated separately from this display data.

dfw-demo-road-legs.json
Only used in the isolated training environment for three matching fictional
coordinates. Derived from © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0).
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
This file is available under the Open Database License. The dataset itself
is distributed with the application as editable JSON and may be independently
downloaded from the relative path vendor/dfw-demo-road-legs.json.

Extract via Overpass API: OSM data timestamp 2026-11-01T08:24:50Z,
major roads through tertiary including links in bounding box
(32.67,-97.16,32.93,-96.73), plus all highways within 550 meters of
each dummy point (32.83,-96.91), (32.778,-96.806), (32.735,-97.079).
Dijkstra shortest estimated time, with basic vehicle access and one-way
directions, excluding private, permit-only and non-motor roads. Speed by
road class, capped by parsed posted speed. Six independent directed paths.
Snapping distances from the three training points: 9.0, 25.4, 18.2 m.
Independent geometry check against Census 2025 Dallas and Tarrant TIGER
edges: 283 samples in all, median separation per directed leg 1.4–3.0 m.
No turn restrictions, truck clearance, weight limits, live traffic or
intersection delays. These cached journeys are planning examples.
